pages.text: Astronauts are people who travel from Earth into space to explore and learn.
In space, astronauts float gently. Gravity feels weaker, so bodies feel light.
Astronauts live inside a space station. It is like a home that circles Earth.
Inside the station, astronauts sleep, eat, and work while floating.
Astronauts wear special space suits when they go outside the station.
Space suits give astronauts air to breathe and protect them from cold and heat.
Astronauts do science in space. They study plants, water, and how bodies move.
Floating helps astronauts learn how things move without strong gravity.
Astronauts work together and help each other stay safe in space.
At bedtime, we remember: astronauts float, wear suits, and learn new things in space.
